name: es30-flat-centroid
title: Flat shading, centroid and sample coverage
summary: Provoking-vertex flat shading (int and float, TRIANGLES/STRIP/FAN), centroid vs. default interpolation on a 4x multisample renderbuffer with a texture-atlas bleed example, and glSampleCoverage / SAMPLE_ALPHA_TO_COVERAGE on multisample renderbuffers and a single-sample FBO, checked with bit-exact readback, stencil sample counting and occlusion queries.
spec: ES 3.0 §2.17 Flatshading, Table 2.12 Provoking vertex selection
ES 3.0 §3.3 Multisampling (SAMPLE_BUFFERS, SAMPLES, multisample rasterization only when SAMPLE_BUFFERS is one)
ES 3.0 §3.6.1 Basic Polygon Rasterization, §3.6.3 Polygon Multisample Rasterization
ES 3.0 §3.9.1 Fragment shader variables (centroid in: sampled within the pixel and the primitive)
ES 3.0 §4.1.3 Multisample Fragment Operations (SampleCoverage, SAMPLE_ALPHA_TO_COVERAGE, clamping, invert)
ES 3.0 §4.1.4 Stencil Test, §4.1.6 Occlusion Queries, §4.1.10 Additional Multisample Fragment Operations

ES 3.0 §4.3.2 Reading Pixels (INVALID_OPERATION on a multisample FBO), §4.3.3 Copying Pixels (the resolve of normalized formats is implementation-dependent, so resolved values are only printed; INVALID_OPERATION into a multisample draw framebuffer)
ES 3.0 §4.4.2.1 RenderbufferStorageMultisample (RENDERBUFFER_SAMPLES >= request), §4.4.4.2 SAMPLE_BUFFERS / SAMPLES of an FBO
ES 3.0 Table 6.7 (multisample state initial values), Table 6.28 (SUBPIXEL_BITS >= 4)
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.3.6 Output Variables (integer outputs must be flat), §4.3.9 Interpolation (flat, centroid, single-sample rule)

api.glSampleCoverage: value 0 writes no sample and value 1 every sample (occlusion query + stencil count), invert flips both, (v,FALSE)+(v,TRUE) write every sample exactly once for 9 values, value 0.5 gives a partial mask; SAMPLE_COVERAGE_VALUE clamped to [0,1]; no effect with SAMPLE_BUFFERS = 0; the resolved band image is only observed (implementation-dependent resolve)
api.glEnable: SAMPLE_COVERAGE / SAMPLE_ALPHA_TO_COVERAGE / STENCIL_TEST / SCISSOR_TEST; enable state read back
api.glDisable: SAMPLE_COVERAGE / SAMPLE_ALPHA_TO_COVERAGE disable read back; DITHER off for exact pixels
api.glIsEnabled: initial FALSE for both multisample operations; TRUE after glEnable, FALSE after glDisable
api.glGetBooleanv: SAMPLE_COVERAGE_INVERT initial FALSE and as set; SAMPLE_COVERAGE / SAMPLE_ALPHA_TO_COVERAGE enable state
api.glGetIntegerv: SAMPLE_BUFFERS / SAMPLES of the multisample FBO (1, = RENDERBUFFER_SAMPLES) and the single-sample FBO (0, 0); MAX_SAMPLES
api.glRenderbufferStorageMultisample: RGBA8 and DEPTH24_STENCIL8 with 4 samples (plus the RGBA8 band target); RENDERBUFFER_SAMPLES >= request and equal for both attachments
api.glRenderbufferStorage: single-sample RGBA8 + DEPTH24_STENCIL8 FBO (SAMPLE_BUFFERS 0) and the RGBA32UI flat-id target
api.glGetRenderbufferParameteriv: RENDERBUFFER_SAMPLES of the multisample attachments (>= request) and of the single-sample FBO's attachments (0)
api.glBlitFramebuffer: multisample -> texture resolves shown in the coverage and zoom panels (panel probes match the read-back resolved texels exactly; the resolved values themselves are only observed, ES 3.0 4.3.3 makes them implementation-dependent); INVALID_OPERATION into a multisample draw framebuffer
api.glReadPixels: RGBA_INTEGER/UNSIGNED_INT from RGBA32UI (bit-exact flat values), RGBA8 readback of the default framebuffer and of resolved textures; INVALID_OPERATION from a multisample FBO
api.glVertexAttribIPointer: uint palette attribute arrives unconverted in the flat uint varying (checked bit-exact)
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLES, TRIANGLE_STRIP and TRIANGLE_FAN with first > 0: gl_VertexID of the provoking vertex checked per triangle
api.glClearBufferuiv: sentinel clear of the RGBA32UI target (unwritten pixels detectable)
api.glBeginQuery: ANY_SAMPLES_PASSED; FALSE and TRUE outcomes both required by different checks
api.glEndQuery: ends the occlusion query around each measured draw
api.glGetQueryObjectuiv: QUERY_RESULT drives the resolve-free coverage and centroid checks
api.glGenQueries: query object used by every occlusion measurement
api.glStencilFunc: EQUAL / NOTEQUAL against the per-sample write count
api.glStencilOp: INCR counts how often each sample was written
api.glColorMask: colour writes off for the stencil-only counting pass (query result depends only on the stencil values)
api.glUniform3fv: 8-entry palette indexed by the flat uint (displayed facets probed)

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi ctest capture (also viewed 800x800 and 333x777): top-left low-poly dusk scene, strip ridge in slate/violet/teal facets, 10-facet fan sun alternating yellow/orange, cyan/pink and yellow/orange kites, every facet one flat colour; top-right 4 x 9 resolved coverage bands, cyan rising and amber falling in quarter steps, the complementary row fully filled amber->cyan, the pink alpha-to-coverage row with a checker dither; bottom-left red-framed magnified tile with magenta bleed pixels along its rotated edges, bottom-right green-framed identical tile with clean edges.
